handbook: Illness is the one exception: a student who is ill may request an extension, but only if medical evidence from a registered doctor reaches the coordinator before the deadline passes.
returns: Reports made after 48 hours are not accepted, except for parcels that were left with a neighbour or a building guard, in which case the 48 hours start from the day the customer actually received the parcel
it_help: The help desk cannot reset a password by phone. The only exception is an account with a registered recovery phone number, where staff may send a one-time code after checking the student ID card in person.
